title: After the day-3 check-in, a recommit to the same step is saved as agreed, with no tool name in the text
origin: Issue #108, live Nov 1: the reply to a recommit after the day-3 check-in began with the line "mark_agreed"

history.text: Hey Sam! Ten pages of Dune on the couch at 6:30 tonight. Ready?
Sam, two nights slipped. Forget the ten: just open Dune tonight and read one page. What's getting in the way?

plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

testerLines: Yes, I still want to read Dune. The plan is fine, I just haven't followed through. Keep the 10 pages at 6:30
whatWentWrong: Live Nov 1: ZOH's reply opened with "mark_agreed" on its own line (the tool's name written as text), and the agreement probably wasn't saved.
shouldHaveHappened: Around 6:20 pm, one text: the honest day-3 check-in. When Sam recommits to the same step at 6:30, ZOH saves the agreement (mark_agreed) and replies briefly and warmly: glad, today's step and time in a line, the photo at the end. No tool name, bracketed note or talk of saving appears in any text, and it doesn't rework the plan Sam just said is fine.
